muscle_engagement.note: EVIDENCE IS MIXED — see caveat below, do not present as settled.
Reduced relative to clavicular in some EMG studies; unchanged in others.

engagement_caveat: EMG literature is genuinely mixed, not settled: some studies (e.g. panoramic ultrasonography cross-sectional area work; European Journal of Sport Sciences 2026 incline-angle study) found significantly higher clavicular activation at incline vs flat. Others (Saeterbakken et al. 2017, elite bench press athletes) found NO significant difference in clavicular vs sternocostal activation across flat/incline/decline. Do not render this exercise as '100% isolates upper chest' in the UI — render as 'shifts emphasis toward clavicular fibers in most but not all studies.'
